blocks.text: Our HVAC technicians are bonded, insured, licensed, and NATE-certified. We keep them continually trained so that they stay up to date on advances in AC technology. Since our trucks are fully stocked, if we must replace a component during our maintenance visit, we can do so without a hassle.

There are several reasons why residents of Live Oak should consider getting regular AC maintenance checks. If you purchase a new system, the warranty likely requires you to get professional tune-ups. Even without such a requirement, though, you should get tune-ups because they keep small issues from growing and hindering AC performance. This means lower utility bills and a lower risk for costly breakdowns.

Rosenberg Plumbing & Air is here to maintain your AC in Live Oak no matter its brand or model. If you take advantage of our Comfort Club Membership, you’ll receive a tune-up every spring and fall. After each tune-up, we’ll write a report of what we did and what we found.

blocks.text: Our team could also check insulation levels and tell you if they are inadequate. We’ll look for any leaks, be they refrigerant leaks or air leaks in the ductwork, and we’ll clear the ductwork of any debris. Air filter replacements are no problem for us, either.

There are numerous benefits for Comfort Club members. First off, you’ll get $20 off all service fees as well as a 15% parts and labor discount. Our repair parts and labor additionally come with a one-year warranty. Members also receive priority status in the event of an emergency.

There’s more to AC maintenance in Live Oak, and our staff at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air is ready to tell you about it over the phone.
